digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store mounting
propositions: rebar init currently creates an empty orphan branch when a remote fetch fails or times out, making a genuinely unreachable remote indistinguishable from a first init
the tri-state remote-branch probe must distinguish reachable-advertised, reachable-absent, and unreachable to avoid orphaning when the remote is genuinely inaccessible

unreachable or timing-out remotes must cause init to fail closed with actionable diagnostics and never enter the interactive consent gate or create an orphan without explicit --force-new-store override
the shared bounded Git-network seam must preserve the 300-second cold-fetch timeout while adding a short bounded advertisement probe via git ls-remote --exit-code

ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount, return without error, and share the cached tri-state result with the following strict path to cost at most one probe timeout per CLI invocation

all four consumers (_mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, _create_tracker) must consume a single shared tri-state remote-branch probe keyed by resolved repo, remote, and branch
